principles.title: Ship, don’t just prototype
principles.desc: I prefer working features that survive real requests, failures and changing requirements.
principles.proof: Production FastAPI services with AI-integrated features at Andela.

principles.title: AI must earn its place
principles.desc: Use an LLM where it creates real product value, not simply because an AI API is available.
principles.proof: In MoodVerse, Gemini interprets the reflection and never writes the verse.

principles.title: Keep systems replaceable
principles.desc: Design integrations so providers, models and infrastructure can change without rewriting core application logic.
principles.proof: Insight Stream integrates OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and Groq.

principles.title: Async when it matters
principles.desc: Move slow or heavy work out of the request path when it improves reliability and response time.
principles.proof: Celery and Redis run ingestion in Insight Stream and price checks in AlertChain.

principles.title: Data before guessing
principles.desc: For knowledge-based AI, use retrieval and trusted data instead of asking a model to invent facts.
principles.proof: SEO Maker’s AI explains findings from measured page data.

principles.title: Simple systems scale better
principles.desc: Prefer clear boundaries, observable workflows and boring infrastructure over unnecessary complexity.
principles.proof: Workroom keeps its AI service separate from the main Django app.

stages.title: User or system
stages.desc: A person or another service sends a request: a question, a search, or an event to process.

stages.title: API endpoint
stages.desc: A typed endpoint validates the input, checks auth and rate limits, then routes the work. Slow jobs go to a background queue.
stages.code:
✓ schema valid (Pydantic)
✓ token verified
✓ under rate limit
→ answers.create()

stages.title: Database
stages.desc: Two lookups run side by side: exact records from PostgreSQL, and meaning-based matches from a vector index.
stages.code:
sql:    plans WHERE seats >= 5
vector: top_k=5 "team pricing"
→ 2 rows, 5 chunks

stages.title: Knowledge
stages.desc: Results are ranked and trimmed into grounded context: the right facts, each with a source the answer can cite.

stages.title: AI model
stages.desc: The model reasons over that context only and returns structured output. Providers can change without touching the app.

stages.title: Response
stages.desc: The user gets an answer grounded in real data, with sources they can check, streamed back to the interface.
